FORM.AppraisalAddendumText: -::- THE INTENDED USER OF THIS APPRAISAL REPORT IS THE LENDER/CLIENT. THE INTENDED USE IS TO EVALUATE THE PROPERTY THAT IS THE SUBJECT OF THIS APPRAISAL FOR A MORTGAGE FINANCE TRANSACTION, SUBJECT TO THE STATED SCOPE OF WORK, PURPOSE OF THE APPRAISAL, REPORTING REQUIREMENTS OF THIS APPRAISAL REPORT FORM, AND DEFINITION OF MARKET VALUE. NO ADDITIONAL INTENDED USERS ARE IDENTIFIED BY THE APPRAISER. THE APPRAISER IS NOT A HOME INSPECTOR AND THE APPRAISAL REPORT IS NOT A HOME INSPECTION. THE APPRAISER ONLY PERFORMED A VISUAL OBSERVATION OF ACCESSIBLE AREAS AND THE APPRAISAL REPORT CANNOT BE RELIED UPON TO DISCLOSE CONDITIONS AND/OR DEFECTS IN THE PROPERTY. THIS APPRAISAL WAS ORDERED IN COMPLIANCE WITH APPRAISAL INDEPENDENCE "AIR" AND MORTGAGEE LETTER 2009-28. STATED SCOPE OF WORK: REFER TO LIMITING CONDITIONS PAGE 1, UNDER "SCOPE OF WORK". I INSPECTED, ON-SITE AND AS PART OF THE SCOPE OF WORK PERFORMED FOR THIS ASSIGNMENT, THE INTERIOR AND EXTERIOR OF THE PROPERTY THAT IS THE SUBJECT OF THIS REPORT. ALSO, THE APPRAISER INSPECTED THE SUBJECT PROPERTY SITE, IMPROVEMENTS INT AND EXT, NOTING ALL READILY AVAILABLE MARKETABILITY FACTORS, PHYSICAL ATTRIBUTES, ETC. THIS ALSO INCLUDES PHYSICAL, ECONOMIC, AND LEGAL CHARACTERISTICS OF THE SUBJECT AND THE EXTERIOR VISUAL NOTATION AND OBSERVATION OF THE COMPARABLES USED, ALONG WITH OTHER PROPERTIES THAT MAY NOT HAVE BEEN USED IN THE REPORT. PUBLIC RECORDS WERE ALSO USED FOR VERIFYING AND GATHERING PERTINENT DATA REGARDING THE SUBJECT AND THE OTHER PROPERTIES ANALYSED IN THE REPORT. THE APPRAISER MADE AN INTERIOR AND EXTERIOR INSPECTION OF ALL READILY ACCESSIBLE AREAS OF THE SUBJECT PROPERTY IMPROVEMENTS. APPRAISER DID NOT MAKE ENTRY INTO ATTIC SCUTTLE OR CRAWL SPACE, AND DID NOT MOVE ANY PERSONAL PROPERTY OR FURNITURE. APPRAISER HAS NOTED ALL READILY OBSERVABLE CONDITIONS OF THE SUBJECT PROPERTY, THAT IS, CONDITIONS THAT ARE IMMEDIATELY NOTICEABLE AND DISCERNIBLE DURING A TYPICAL SITE VISIT. APPRAISER IS NOT RESPONSIBLE FOR DETERMINING THE FUNCTIONALITY OF APPLIANCES OR MECHANICAL SYSTEMS. THE APPRAISER IS NOT COMPETENT TO MAKE A JUDGEMENT REGARDING THE CONDITION RELATING TO THE SUBJECT'S FOUNDATION, INTERIOR OF THE WALLS, ROOF, ETC, OTHER THAN WHAT IS READILY OBSERVABLE. THE REPORTED CONDITIONS ONLY REFLECT THE APPARENT SURFACE CONDITION. SHOULD THE CLIENT/READER OF THE REPORT HAVE CONCERNS REGARDING THE CONDITION OF THESE ITEMS, AN INSPECTION BY A QUALIFIED INSPECTOR/CONTRACTORS RECOMMENDED. THE APPRAISER'S INSPECTION INCLUDED A COMPLETE INTERIOR AND EXTERIOR INSPECTION OF ALL VISIBLE AREAS OF THE SUBJECT PROPERTY. THE APPRAISER'S INSPECTION DID NOT INCLUDE IDENTIFICATION OR TESTING FOR MOLD, RADON, UFFI, ASBESTOS, OR OTHER ENVIRONMENTAL HAZARDS, AS IDENTIFICATION OF THESE SUBSTANCES IS BEYOND THE SCOPE OF THE APPRAISER'S EXPERTISE. COMPARABLES IN THE AREA WERE RESEARCHED, SOME WERE USED IN THE REPORT, SOME WERE NOT USED, DUE TO VARYING FACTORS. A REPORT WAS COMPLETED, AS ORDERED BY CLIENT AND APPLICABLE TO THE ASSIGNMENT. THE REPORT WAS DELIVERED TO THE CLIENT. PER CLIENT REQUIREMENT: MY COMPARABLE SEARCH AND RESULTS: THE SUBJECT PROPERTY WAS RESEARCHED THROUGH AVAILABLE DATA SOURCES INCLUDING AT LEAST : PARCELQUEST (PQT) AND MLS, AND ALSO COULD HAVE INCLUDED TITLE COMPANIES AND GOVERNMENTAL COUNTY/CITY WEBSITES THAT THE SUBJECT IS LOCATED IN. THE INITIAL COMPARABLE SALE SEARCH FOCUSED ON SALES, LISTINGS AND PENDING SALES WITH TRANSACTION DATES WITHIN 12 MONTHS AND LOCATED IN THE MARKET AREA. NOTE, SOMETIMES THE MARKET AREA EXTENDS TO BEYOND THE 1 MILE FNMA GUIDELINE. THE GLA OF THE POSSIBLE SALES WAS LIMITED TO 25 % OF THE SUBJECT'S GLA. THE SEARCH RESULTED IN 16 SALES AND 1 LISTING. NOTE THIS DATA IS ALSO REFLECTED WITH STRONGER ANALYZATION WITHIN THE REPORT (PAGE 2 AND THE MC FORM, IF SUPPLIED). MANY OF THE SALES AND LISTINGS THAT FIT THE SEARCH PARAMETERS WERE DISCARDED AS THE **MOST** COMPARABLE AND **BEST** SUBSTITUTE PROPERTIES (AS REQUIRED BY USPAP) WERE USED IN THE REPORT. THIS APPRAISER HAS PREPARED THIS APPRAISAL IN FULL COMPLIANCE WITH THE APPRAISER INDEPENDENCE REQUIREMENTS AND HAS NOT PERFORMED, PARTICIPATED IN, OR BEEN ASSOCIATED WITH ANY ACTIVITY IN VIOLATION OF CODE. ADDITIONAL COMMENTS: APPRAISER CERTIFIES THAT, TO THE BEST OF MY KNOWLEDGE AND BELIEF: THE STATEMENTS OF FACT CONTAINED IN THIS REPORT ARE TRUE AND CORRECT. THE REPORTED ANALYSES, OPINIONS, AND CONCLUSIONS ARE LIMITED ONLY BY THE REPORTED ASSUMPTIONS AND LIMITING CONDITIONS AND ARE MY PERSONAL, IMPARTIAL, AND UNBIASED PROFESSIONAL ANALYSES, OPINIONS, AND CONCLUSIONS. I HAVE NO PRESENT OR PROSPECTIVE INTEREST IN THE PROPERTY THAT IS THE SUBJECT OF THIS REPORT AND NO PERSONAL INTEREST WITH RESPECT TO THE PARTIES INVOLVED. I HAVE NO BIAS WITH RESPECT TO THE PROPERTY THAT IS THE SUBJECT OF THIS REPORT OR TO THE PARTIES INVOLVED WITH THIS ASSIGNMENT. MY ENGAGEMENT IN THIS ASSIGNMENT WAS NOT CONTINGENT UPON DEVELOPING OR REPORTING PREDETERMINED RESULTS. MY COMPENSATION FOR COMPLETING THIS ASSIGNMENT IS NOT CONTINGENT UPON THE DEVELOPMENT OR REPORTING OF A PREDETERMINED VALUE OR DIRECTION IN VALUE THAT FAVORS THE CAUSE OF THE CLIENT, THE AMOUNT OF THE VALUE OPINION, THE ATTAINMENT OF A STIPULATED RESULT, OR THE OCCURRENCE OF A SUBSEQUENT EVENT DIRECTLY RELATED TO THE INTENDED USE OF THIS APPRAISAL. MY ANALYSES, OPINIONS, AND CONCLUSIONS WERE DEVELOPED, AND THIS REPORT HAS BEEN PREPARED, IN CONFORMITY WITH THE UNIFORM STANDARDS OF PROFESSIONAL APPRAISAL PRACTICE. I HAVE MADE A PERSONAL INSPECTION OF THE PROPERTY THAT IS THE SUBJECT OF THIS REPORT. THE APPRAISER MADE AN INTERIOR AND EXTERIOR INSPECTION OF ALL READILY ACCESSIBLE AREAS OF THE SUBJECT PROPERTY IMPROVEMENTS. APPRAISER DID NOT MAKE ENTRY INTO ATTIC SCUTTLE OR CRAWL SPACE, AND DID NOT MOVE ANY PERSONAL PROPERTY OR FURNITURE. APPRAISER HAS NOTED ALL READILY OBSERVABLE CONDITIONS OF THE SUBJECT PROPERTY, THAT IS, CONDITIONS THAT ARE IMMEDIATELY NOTICEABLE AND DISCERNIBLE DURING A TYPICAL SITE VISIT. APPRAISER IS NOT RESPONSIBLE FOR DETERMINING THE FUNCTIONALITY OF APPLIANCES OR MECHANICAL SYSTEMS. THE APPRAISER IS NOT A HOME OR ENVIRONMENTAL INSPECTOR. THE APPRAISER PROVIDES AN OPINION OF VALUE. THE APPRAISAL DOES NOT GUARANTEE THAT THE PROPERTY IS FREE OF DEFECTS OR ENVIRONMENTAL PROBLEMS. THE APPRAISER PERFORMS AN INSPECTION OF VISIBLE AND ACCESSIBLE AREAS ONLY. LENDER / CLIENT : Vista Point Mortgage, LLC dba Brokers Advantage Mortgage -:NEIGHBORHOOD DESCRIPTION:- THE MARKET AREA CONTAINS MOSTLY SINGLE FAMILY RESIDENCES, WITH SOME CONDOS, AND COMMERCIAL, OF MIXED AGES, AND STYLES. THE AREA IS CONFORMING TO OTHER PROXIMATE AREAS IN THE REGION. THE SFRS IN THE AREA GENERALLY WELL MAINTAINED WITH EFFECTIVE AGES TYPICALLY LOWER THAN ACTUAL AGES. COMMERCIAL, SOME EMPLOYMENT, SCHOOLS, AND FREEWAYS ARE ACCESSED BY WAY OF VENTURA BLVD , WHICH IS THE MAIN THOROUGHFARE IN THE AREA. THE MARKET VALUES IN THE AREA ARE BASICALLY DETERMINED BY LOT SIZE, GLA, AND CONDITION OF THE IMPROVEMENTS. THE AREA IS WITHIN 2 MILES OF THE 101 FREEWAY. -:NEIGHBORHOOD MARKET CONDITIONS:- THE MARKET AREA , PER LOCAL MLS AND PER THE MC FORM, IS BASICALLY STABLE AT THIS TIME IN REGARDS TO MARKET VALUES. IN THE PAST, THE AREA (AND THE REGION) HAD A LONG PERIOD OF INCREASES, THEN DECLINED. HOWEVER, THE RECENT DATA IS SHOWING STABILIZATION. THE AREA ALSO HAS DEMAND/SUPPLY IN BALANCE, AND MARKET TIMES OF GENERALLY UNDER 90 DAYS, ALTHOUGH IN MICRO AREAS, AND INDIVIDUAL SALES, THE MARKET TIMES CAN DEVIATE FROM THE NORM. THE AREA IS SUBURBAN AND HAS STABLE GROWTH, BUT IS FULLY DEVELOPED (CHANGE IN LAND USE CAN OCCUR). SELLER FINANCING IS COMMON, AND SOME DOWNPAYMENT ASSISTANCE DOES OCCUR FROM GOVERNMENT OR COMMUNITY PROGRAMS. -:SITE COMMENTS:- THE SUBJECT SITE IS TYPICALLY SIZED FOR THE AREA. THE SITE HAS AVERAGE MARKET APPEAL. THE TITLE REPORT WAS NOT SUPPLIED FOR REVIEW. TYPICAL UTILITY EASEMENTS EXIST. ANY OTHER EASEMENTS OF NOTE ARE DESCRIBED BELOW. DRAINAGE APPEARS TO BE ADEQUATE. I HAVE NOT CHECKED THE LAND RECORDS FOR RECORDED EASEMENTS AND HAVE REPORTED ONLY APPARENT EASEMENTS, ENCROACHMENTS AND OTHER APPARENT ADVERSE CONDITIONS. THE SUBJECT NOR THE MARKET AREA HAS BEEN AFFECTED BY THE RECENT WILDFIRES, FLOODING, MUDFLOWS AND DEBRIS FLOWS IN THE REGION. THE APPRAISAL INSTITUTE DEFINES HIGHEST AND BEST USE AS FOLLOWS: THE REASONABLY PROBABLE AND LEGAL USE OF VACANT LAND OR AN IMPROVED PROPERTY THAT IS PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE, APPROPRIATELY SUPPORTED, FINANCIALLY FEASIBLE, AND THAT RESULTS IN THE HIGHEST VALUE. THE FOUR CRITERIA THE HIGHEST AND BEST USE MUST MEET ARE LEGAL PERMISSIBILITY, PHYSICAL POSSIBILITY, FINANCIAL FEASIBILITY, AND MAXIMUM PRODUCTIVITY. ALTERNATIVELY, THE PROBABLE USE OF LAND OR IMPROVED PROPERTY - SPECIFIC WITH RESPECT TO THE USER AND TIMING OF THE USE - THAT IS ADEQUATELY SUPPORTED AND RESULTS IN THE HIGHEST PRESENT VALUE. THE HIGHEST AND BEST USE OF THE SUBJECT IS AN SFR HOME. THAT IS SUPPORTED BY THE ZONING, THE TYPICAL USE IN THE AREA, AND WILL HAVE THE GREATEST RETURN ON INVESTMENT. THE SUBJECT SITE *CANNOT* BE DEVELOPED FOR MULTI FAMILY, CONDO, COMMERCIAL, INDUSTRIAL, DUE TO ZONING, AND THAT WOULD CREATE A SIGNIFICANT NON HOMOGENEITY IN THE AREA, AND WOULD NOT BE ALLOWED BY THE COUNTY/CITY. THE SUBJECT HIGHEST AND BEST USE IS SFR. SINCE IT IS ALREADY DEVELOPED, VACANT LAND IS NOT ITS HIGHEST AND BEST EITHER. THE EXISTING IMPROVEMENTS ARE LEGALLY PERMITTED, PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE, FINANCIALLY FEASIBLE AND MAXIMUM PRODUCTIVE AND RESULTED IN A CONCLUSION THAT THE CURRENT USE OF THE SUBJECT PROPERTY IS THE HIGHEST AND BEST USE. FEMA DISASTER COMMENTARY: THE SUBJECT PROPERTY HAS NOT BEEN IMPACTED BY THE RECENT FIRE DISASTER. THE SUBJECT PROPERTY VALUE AND MARKETABILITY HAVE NOT BEEN AFFECTED. CORNER LOT, NO ADVERSITY NOTED. -:ADDITIONAL FEATURES:- THE SUBJECT FEATURES : PATIO, FENCE, BUILT INS. THE SUBJECT HAS A PERMITTED ACCESSORY DWELLING UNIT (ADU). IT HAS ITS OWN ADDRESS AND UTILITIES. ADUS ARE NOT COMMON FOR THE AREA, BUT DO OCCUR, AND ARE MARKET ACCEPTABLE. THE ADU ADDS MARKETABILITY TO THE PROPERTY. PERMIT #26014-10000-01588, CERT OF OCCUPANCY IN PROGRESS (FINAL PERMITS COMPLETED) 06/28/2026. THE ADU IS NOT CURRENTLY LEASED. THE ADU MAY BE LEGALLY LEASED. THE ADU CONTAINS: 3 BED, 3.1 BATH, LIVING ROOM, KITCHEN. UTILITIES ARE ON AT TIME OF INSPECTION. THE SUBJECT IS A 1 STORY DETACHED SINGLE FAMILY HOUSE WITH 1100 ABOVE-GRADE FINISHED SQUARE FEET. IN ADDITION, THE PROPERTY INCLUDES A PATIO, PORCH, AND ADU. REFER TO SKETCH PAGE FOR SQFT BREAKDOWNS. THE SUBJECT WAS MEASURED AND REPORTED CONFORMING TO ANSI STANDARDS. -:CONDITION OF THE PROPERTY:- -:PHYSICAL DEFICIENCIES OR ADVERSE CONDITIONS:- -:COMMENTS ON SALES COMPARISON:- SUBJECT AND ALL COMPS ARE LOCATED WITHIN THE SAME OR SIMILAR, COMPETING MARKET AREA. ALL ADJUSTMENTS WERE MADE BASED UPON PAIRED SALES ANALYSIS. THEREFORE, ADJUSTMENTS THAT WERE MADE REFLECT THE REACTION OF TYPICAL BUYERS AND SELLERS IN THE SUBJECT MARKET AREA. MLS WAS CONSULTED FOR SPECIFIC DETAILS REGARDING THE COMPARABLES USED, INCLUDING APPEAL, DESIGN, AND AMENITIES. DUE TO THE LIMITED MARKET AREA, ALL COMPS ARE AT/OVER 6 MONTHS, AND COMPS HAVE WIDE RANGE OF GLA, SALES PRICES AND ADJUSTED VALUES, AND COMPS 4 AND 5 ARE OVER 1 MILE AWAY. ALTHOUGH SOME COMPS CROSS A MAJOR ARTERY, THEY ARE IN A SIMILAR, COMPETING MARKET AREA AS THE SUBJECT. THE CLIENT REQUESTS 2 LISTINGS TO BE USED IN THE GRID, HOWEVER, AFTER RESEARCHING THE AREA, ONLY 1 COMPETITIVE LISTING WAS NOTED. THEREFORE 4 CLOSED SALES WERE USED FOR SUPPORT. THE COMPS USED BRACKET ALL OF THE SUBJECT'S SALIENT FEATURES, EXCEPT GLA, HOWEVER, COMP 3 GLA IS EQUAL IN THE MARKET TO THE SUBJECT GLA. THE SUBJECT IS NOT UNDERADEQUATE FOR THE AREA, NO LOSS IN MARKETABILITY. THE SUBJECT IS ABOVE PREDOMINANT VALUE DUE TO ADU AMENITY. THE SUBJECT IS NOT A SUPERADEQUACY FOR THE AREA, NO LOSS IN MARKETABILITY. NOTE, BY USING PAIRED SALES ANALYSIS, IT WAS NOTED THAT THE MARKET DOES NOT REACT TO THE VARIANCE BETWEEN THE SUBJECT AND THE COMPS FOR : AGE, BED COUNT, OR DESIGN/STYLE. HOWEVER, THE MARKET WILL REACT TO THE DIFFERENCES FOR : LOT SIZE, BATH COUNT, GLA, ADU, CONDITION, PARKING. MOST WEIGHT TO COMP 4 DUE TO ADU, AND PARKING, WITH SOME WEIGHT TO COMP 1 DUE TO PROXIMITY, COMP 2 GIVEN WEIGHT DUE TO CONDITION AND PROXIMITY, COMP 3 GIVEN WEIGHT DUE TO CONDITION, GLA, AND BATH COUNT, AND LISTING 5 CONSIDERED, SHOWING CURRENT TRENDING. THE APPRAISER HAS ADJUSTED DISSIMILARITIES BETWEEN THE SUBJECT AND COMPARABLES ACCORDING TO THE MARKET REACTION. THEREFORE, THE DISSIMILARITIES THAT HAVE A 0 INDICATED IN THE ADJUSTMENT COLUMN MEANS THE APPRAISER HAS ACKNOWLEDGED THE DIFFERENCE; HOWEVER, THE MARKET DOES NOT SUPPORT ANY ADJUSTMENT. MARKET CONDITION DATA: THE COMPARABLES SELECTED WERE DEEMED TO BE THE MOST SIMILAR IN PROXIMITY, USE, AND MOST SIMILAR IN SALIENT FEATURES (GLA, BED/BATH COUNT, LOT SIZE, AMENITIES, ETC) TO THE SUBJECT, AND THE MOST RECENT SALES THAT FIT THESE GROUPINGS. THE MARKET CONDITIONS WERE ADJUSTED BASED UPON: A 12 MONTH TIME FRAME, THAT SUPPORTS BOTH THE INDICATED OVERALL MARKET TREND AND MARKET- DERIVED TIME ADJUSTMENTS FOR CHANGES IN MARKET CONDITIONS, INCLUDING FACTUAL DATA FROM THE LOCAL MLS DATA SOURCE (REFER TO GRAPHS AND DATA SUPPLIED). Date of sale search was extended to include sales up to 24 months. Adjustments reflect changes in the average sale price per month within the broad market. The following specific adjustments were applied: Comp #1: A -0.26% change from contract date,no adjustment warranted. Comp #2: A -0.38% change from contract date, no adjustment warranted. Comp #3: A -0.17% change from contract date, no adjustment warranted. Comp #4: A -0.22% change from contract date, no adjustment warranted. -:FINAL RECONCILIATION:- -:CONDITIONS OF APPRAISAL:- -:COST APPROACH COMMENTS:- LAND Value by abstraction. Land to improvement ratio typical for the area. NATIONAL BUILDING COST ESTIMATOR SOFTWARE used for cost approach figures. Age/life method used for physical depreciation. Estimated total economic life is 70 years. This data is not to be used for insurance purposes. At the request of the client, development of the cost approach has been attempted by the appraiser as an analysis to support their opinion of the property's market value. Because there is insufficient market evidence to credibly support the site value/derivation of total depreciation, the cost approach is not given any consideration in the appraiser's final analysis. Use of this data, in whole or in part, for other purposes is not intended by the appraiser. Nothing set forth in the appraisal should be relied upon for the purpose of determining the amount or type of insurance coverage to be placed on the subject property. The appraiser assumes no liability for and does not guarantee that any insurable value estimate inferred from this report will result in the subject property being fully insured for any loss that may be sustained. The appraiser recommends that an insurance professional be consulted. Further, the cost approach may not be a reliable indication of replacement or reproduction cost for any date other than the effective date of this appraisal due to changing costs of labor and materials and due to changing building codes and governmental regulations and requirements.
